title: 7-element f/1.75 main-camera lens, 34.5° half field (US9366845B2 example 5)

collection.attribution: Largan Precision Co., Ltd., US9366845B2 "Photographing optical lens assembly, image capturing unit and electronic device". The prescription is the published numerical example; the native Project is a transcription of Table 1 and Table 2.
collection.redistribution: The numerical prescription is published in a granted US patent, a public record. The transcription, the native Project and this evidence extract are distributed under MIT. The patent document itself is not redistributed.

aperture_validity.basis: The stop row is an opaque plate whose opening is narrower than the neighbouring elements.
aperture_validity.satisfaction_basis: No field-dependent MTF, relative-illumination or pupil measurement is recorded for this record, so a stop-dependent match is not claimed.

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: SOURCE_STATED reference wavelength (d-line, 587.6 nm as printed).
spectrum.wavelength_precision: The source states one reference wavelength; no other sample is claimed.

continuous_coverage_nm.note: The publication states a single reference wavelength, not a specified band.

image_format.basis: DERIVED from the traced chief-ray image height at the largest field that the transcribed prescription traces cleanly; the source states field angles, not a sensor format.

effective_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial EFL at the reference wavelength
effective_focal_length_mm.conditions: Reference wavelength 587.56 nm; object at infinity.

back_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial distance from the exit vertex to the rear focal point

total_track_mm.definition: Sum of the tabulated thicknesses from the first surface to the image plane in the committed Project. Where the stop standoff was adjusted, the 0.05 mm stop gap is included, so the value is 0.05 mm longer than the publication's own track.

engine_check.method: Thick-lens ABCD through the committed Project at the reference wavelength.

comparison.rule: |engine - source| <= atol + rtol * |source|. atol covers the printed 2-decimal focal length; rtol covers the 3-decimal radii and thicknesses and the engine's air-referenced index convention (about 0.13 % on EFL).

f_number.definition: Image-space f-number as printed for the example

entrance_pupil_diameter_mm.definition: EFL / f-number, on the same reference wavelength

stop_opening_diameter_mm.definition: Diameter of the modelled stop opening that reproduces the stated f-number

field.definition: Half of the maximal field of view, the quantity the publication prints as HFOV.

verification.basis: Chief rays traced through the committed prescription at the reference wavelength; the image height at the largest traced field is recorded above.

materials.basis: Each plastic or glass is modelled from the source's printed nd and Abbe number: a two-term Cauchy curve through (nd, Vd) is fitted by a three-term Sellmeier with fixed poles over 450-660 nm.

model_glasses.basis: ND_VD_CAUCHY_SELLMEIER fit to the printed nd and Vd
ND_VD_CAUCHY_SELLMEIER fit to the printed nd and Vd
ND_VD_CAUCHY_SELLMEIER fit to the printed nd and Vd

approximations.description: The publication states nd and Vd only. A two-term Cauchy curve is solved exactly from those two values and a three-term Sellmeier with fixed poles is fitted to it over 450-660 nm. The index at the reference wavelength is the source's nd; the dispersion curve is a model.

The Project's environment is air, so the engine reports the effective focal length relative to the air index at the reference wavelength; the source's own focal length is a design value. The difference is about 0.13 % and is inside the stated comparison tolerance.

The publication states no clear apertures. Each semi-diameter is derived from the traced beam envelope at 0, 0.5 and 0.7 of the stated half-field with a 7 % mechanical allowance, and is capped where the aspheric polynomial stops being physically usable.

The publication lists the stop a negative distance in front of the first surface (-0.614 mm). The surface table carries positive spacings only, so the stop plane sits 0.05 mm in front of the first surface instead.

evidence_notes: Engine paraxial EFL 5.600244 mm against the source's printed 5.59 mm.
Stop opening solved to 3.196200 mm so the modelled f-number reproduces the printed value.
